field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Empty because this task invokes no LLM.
field_principles.authority_sidecar_hash: The authority digest binds hidden truth and timing.
field_principles.authority_sidecar_path: The scorer alone holds full truth and feedback timing.
field_principles.capacity_delay_contract: Explicit queue rules make every capacity cell replayable.
field_principles.checkpoint_hash: The checkpoint digest binds completed computation units.
field_principles.checkpoint_path: Real progress is stored outside the terminal deliverable.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed work; never pad time to pass a floor.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host or device identity limits the scope of the evidence.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed ID prevents another task from supplying this evidence.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo each declared reason beside the actual evidence contract.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the failed check, upstream, field, expected and observed value.
field_principles.headroom_rows: A zero-error oracle is an upper bound, not an attainable accuracy target.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ or complete: for completed findings, including nulls; blocked_* for external blocks. Never promote infrastructure readiness as scientific benefit.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe executed computation, not the planned workload.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Apply the duration floor for the work actually performed.
field_principles.information_budget_rows: The frozen and adaptive controls start with equal information.
field_principles.milestone: The milestone binds the stream to the V634 contract.
field_principles.model_invoked: False; upstream inference is cited, not repeated.
field_principles.mutation_audit_rows: Named attacks must fail before readiness can become one.
field_principles.panel_hash: One digest binds all scheduler comparisons and budget receipts.
field_principles.pending_queue_rows: Boundary receipts expose admission, occupancy, and release order.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record each required resource and its actual observed state.
field_principles.prior_null_gate_receipt: The old zero-value result stays a null input, not headroom.
field_principles.public_stream_path: Learner-visible fields omit hidden parameters and future labels.
field_principles.public_view_hash: The public-view digest detects post-freeze learner-input changes.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze all stochastic choices before reading held-out outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash inputs, code, seeds and raw rows.
field_principles.rows: Retain unit ID, arm, seed, metric, error and abstention for every comparison.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned and completed counts, independent units and exclusions.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema makes incompatible readers fail closed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind code, inputs and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.source_grounding_rows: Extraction and two exact scorers bind public input to truth.
field_principles.status: Terminal only after completion or a diagnosed external block.
field_principles.stream_capacity_ready_score: Readiness certifies information and timing contracts, not learnability.
field_principles.stream_manifest: Freeze all ten seeds, 1024 events and delay/capacity cells.
field_principles.stream_manifest_hash: The manifest digest exposes outcome-driven contract edits.
field_principles.stream_manifest_path: A separate manifest lets later tasks inspect frozen contracts.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only incomplete own work can be partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True when verification uses the same correctness authority; separate implementations alone do not remove circularity.
field_principles.warmup_state_rows: State hashes prove equal information at the freeze boundary.

checks.expected_value: sha256:<64 hex> for every source and upstream artifact

honest_verdict: complete: bounded feedback stream ready; no learning benefit measured
inference_substrate: deterministic CPU finite-domain predicates, bounded pending-queue scheduling, and exact replay; no model invocation

preconditions_checked.expected_value: sha256:<64 hex> for every source and upstream artifact

families.cyclic_window: accept iff (numeric_value mod 33 - hidden_parameter) mod 33 is below 8
families.lower_bound: accept iff numeric_value mod 33 is at least hidden_parameter
families.modular_equals: accept iff numeric_value mod 33 equals hidden_parameter
families.upper_bound: accept iff numeric_value mod 33 is at most hidden_parameter
